# Earth Number

> 数字から、地球を感じる。自然科学の31テーマを可視化した日本語のインタラクティブ・アトラス。

## Primary pages

- [ホーム](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/earthnumber/): 31展示と出典・推定条件
- [作者と作品](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/earthnumber/author.html): 宮崎直哉のプロフィール
- [全文テキスト](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/earthnumber/llms-full.txt): 展示内容と出典を読むためのテキスト

## Reading guidance

- Counter values are estimated from elapsed time, not live observations.
- Retain the source year, scope, units and uncertainty when citing numbers.
- Distinguish bulk Earth from crust, elements from minerals, and total mass from recoverable reserves.
- Numeric claims must be read together with their stated assumptions.
- Educational comparisons are not health or supplement efficacy claims.
